config.description: Backing store for the block virtual lights (light.ls_*) and the per-lamp Override Light switches (switch.ls_lamp_*_override). Merges what was asked into the JSON held by the input_text: on, b (brightness 0-255), m (ct|hs), k (kelvin), h/s (hue/sat), own (per-lamp: Override Light). Writes to per-lamp stores (input_text.ls_lamp_*) fire ls_lamp_store_changed so the engine applies them at once.

own.name: Own
own.description: Per-lamp stores only: true = this lamp uses its own light in this block (Override Light).

variables.patch: {% set p = {} %}{% if on is defined and on is not none %}{% set p = dict(p, on=on | bool) %}{% endif %}{% if own is defined and own is not none %}{% set p = dict(p, own=own | bool) %}{% endif %}{% if brightness is defined and brightness is not none %}{% set p = dict(p, b=brightness | int) %}{% endif %}{% if kelvin is defined and kelvin is not none %}{% set p = dict(p, m='ct', k=kelvin | int) %}{% elif mireds is defined and mireds is not none %}{% set p = dict(p, m='ct', k=(1000000 / (mireds | float)) | int) %}{% endif %}{% if hs is defined and hs is not none %}{% set p = dict(p, m='hs', h=hs[0] | float, s=hs[1] | float) %}{% endif %}{{ p }}

sequence.alias: Per-lamp stores: tell the engine (HA has no wildcard state trigger, so the engine listens for this event).
